=== instructions === #+TITLE: Procurement desk — operational contract

* Work in scoped files
Desk ID and operation are in your task goal. Read the qualification profile.
Your cwd is this desk folder. Write public outputs with local filenames. Do not rewrite generated desk.bl.org
or opportunity-ID.bl.org: desk-tool publishes these from durable structured facts.
Create named reusable BEAM Lisp functions in search.bl and matching source blocks
in search.bl.org BEFORE discovery. Reuse or repair previous functions. Execute
those functions, save actual page text and cite original URLs. This is BEAM Lisp:
no js/JSON.parse or Java classes. Use sh maps :out/:exit; inspect failures.

* Loading saved functions
search.bl is loaded into your task namespace before every eval. Call its named
functions directly. No manual load-string or copying definitions is required.
File edits are picked up on the next eval. Keep definitions in valid BEAM Lisp.

* Browser
(sh "node browser-tool.mjs open https://example.org/")
For arbitrary JS or URLs write a local literal argument file then:
(sh "node browser-tool.mjs eval --arg-file argument.txt")
The result is readable page text. Use document.body.innerText, DOM selectors,
links, snapshot. Do not inject giant page dumps into the model: read only the
relevant fields/sections (about 10000 characters). Use browser-tool.mjs download
with an element ref and a root-relative desks/DESK/FILENAME destination.
For multiple arguments write a JSON array to args.json, then use
(sh "node browser-tool.mjs download --args-file args.json").
If clicking a download navigates to a request form instead, read that form.
A download timeout does not prove the document is unavailable. Before
extracting archives inspect their file list. pdftotext/unzip are available if
installed; record actual file/page references for eligibility claims.
Page and token limits are enforced by the local browser gateway. If reached,
save partial outputs and done. Do not loop formatting or retry WAF challenges.

* Publishing structured opportunities
Write JSON to local update.json then call:
(sh "node desk-tool.mjs update --arg-file update.json")
JSON schema:
{"desk":"DESK","opportunity":{"id":"safe-lowercase-id",
"title":"Original title","buyer":"Buyer or unknown","country":"Morocco",
"url":"https://official/original","deadline":"2026-10-27 11:00",
"timezone":"unspecified","fit":"moderate","stage":"notice-checked",
"decision":"needs-information","summary":"Evidence-backed interpretation",
"unknowns":["Qlik references unknown"],"nextAction":"Read qualification rules",
"evidence":["desks/DESK/evidence-name.txt"],"rationale":"Why this decision"}}
Allowed stages: discovered, notice-checked, dossier-reviewed, qualification-checked.
Advanced stages require a nonempty requirements array in publishing JSON:
"requirements":[{"requirement":"Exact qualification requirement",
"document":"desks/DESK/dossier-pdf.txt","page":"3 / section 4",
"fact":"Profile references unknown","verdict":"unknown"}]
Every requirement document must appear in evidence, with actual page/section
references. Verdicts are met, unknown or not-met. Pursue requires all requirements
met and no remaining unknowns. Include availability: open, closed or unverified.
Advance only from evidence actually read. For dossier-reviewed cite a real
consultation document with page/section references. Qualification-checked means
requirements were compared against sourced profile facts; unknowns may remain.
Pursue requires qualification-checked, but never pretend missing facts are met.
Allowed decisions: needs-information, pursue, reject. Preserve existing notices
on refresh; update fields only with evidence, including closed/deadline changes.

* Document output
Use #+USE: present,browser,procurement and #+PROCUREMENT_DESK: DESK in the
first twelve lines of profile, search docs, qualification and run reports.
This loads the experience when opening a file in the local demo. Keep code
source blocks exact; do not perform complicated formatting transformations.
The presentation wraps prose. Unknown company qualifications must remain unknown.
Dossier report: requirements → page reference → profile fact → met/unknown/not met.
Give a candid decision and immediate next actions. Never claim eligibility from
marketing text. Read no more pages than the goal permits. Finish within sixteen
model steps, preferably ten. Save the run report and call (done "summary").

* Auth and actions
Browser control belongs to the task; the user can pause/resume and switch modes.
No credentials in public files or source. Temporary email registration is allowed
only if needed for public consultation documents, through browser interaction.
Do not fabricate a company's legal identity or accept contracts on its behalf.
No buyer contact, bid submission, payment or applications. If login/identity
requirements prevent document access, record the exact blocker and next action.

 #+USE: present,browser,procurement
#+PROCUREMENT_DESK: ora
#+TITLE: ONMT — conversational AI and BI on Qlik Sense — qualification report
#+DATE: 2026-10-08
#+STAGE: qualification-checked
#+DECISION: needs-information

* Outcome
Eligibility of Ora Ventures for this tender is UNKNOWN (needs-information). The
consultation dossier was obtained and read this run; concrete mandatory
requirements were extracted from the Règlement de Consultation (RC) and the
Cahier des Prescriptions Spéciales (CPS) with PDF page references. Ora's profile
does not state the legal, financial or reference facts needed to satisfy them, so
no requirement can be marked met and the decision cannot be pursue. Nothing here
claims any certification or bid eligibility.

* Documents actually read (local DCE from dossier.zip)
- desks/ora/dce/RC.txt — Règlement de Consultation, 26 PDF pages (from RC.pdf).
- desks/ora/dce/CPS.txt — Cahier des Prescriptions Spéciales, 24 PDF pages (from CPS.pdf).
- Original notice: https://www.marchespublics.gov.ma/index.php?page=entreprise.EntrepriseDetailsConsultation&refConsultation=1044940&orgAcronyme=o3f (ref DA/15/26, deadline 27/10/2026 11:00).
- Ora profile facts: desks/ora/profile.bl.org (marketing claims only).

* Requirements -> document/page -> profile fact -> verdict
1. Two references/attestations mandatory: one on the deployment and integration
   of Qlik Sense in the domain of activity, and one on the implementation of an
   AI solution; the offer is rejected if not provided.
   - RC.txt PDF page 7 (Article 5, dossier technique, N.B.)
   - Profile claims AI/chatbot work and custom AI tools but lists only anonymized
     client stories; Qlik Sense is never mentioned and no attestations exist.
   - Verdict: UNKNOWN
2. Minimum team profiles: chef de projet (Bac+4, >=1 AI project AND >=1 BI
   project); Expert IA (Bac+4, >=1 AI project); Expert Business Intelligence —
   Qlik Sense (Bac+4, >=1 Qlik Sense project); Développeur full stack (web +
   mobile). Any offer without these minimum profiles is rejected.
   - RC.txt PDF page 8 (Article 6, offre technique)
   - Profile states no team members, qualifications or project references.
   - Verdict: UNKNOWN
3. Administrative capacity: legal, technical and financial capacities; fiscal
   regularity attestation (percepteur du lieu d'imposition); CNSS regularity
   attestation; RCCM model 9 where applicable; activity in relation to the object.
   - RC.txt PDF pages 5-6 (Article 4; Article 5.I.A)
   - Profile states no domicile, registration, tax or social-security status.
   - Verdict: UNKNOWN
4. Provisional guarantee of 20,000.00 dirhams with the offer; definitive guarantee
   of 3% of the contract sum (3% must be an unconditional bank guarantee from an
   approved Moroccan body).
   - CPS.txt PDF page 6 (Article 14, Cautionnement)
   - Profile states no financial guarantees.
   - Verdict: UNKNOWN
5. Language: dossier and technical documents in French only (Arabic accepted for
   the dossier per Article 6 wording).
   - RC.txt PDF page 7 and Sommaire/Article 6
   - Profile site is EN/FR marketing, not a contractual-language certification.
   - Verdict: UNKNOWN

* Blocker
None for reading: the DCE is on disk. The blockers are factual — Ora's profile
does not evidence Qlik Sense references, named attestations, team CVs, Moroccan
legal/tax/CNSS registration or guarantees, so qualification cannot be established.

* Immediate next actions
1. Obtain at least one named, attestable Qlik Sense deployment/integration
   reference and one named AI-solution implementation reference (Article 5 N.B.).
2. Assemble the four minimum team CVs (chef de projet, IA, BI/Qlik, full-stack)
   with the required per-project experience.
3. Prepare Moroccan administrative evidence (fiscal and CNSS attestations, RCCM
   model 9) if a Moroccan entity or partner is intended.
4. Budget the 20,000 MAD provisional guarantee and confirm an approved Moroccan
   guarantor for the 3% definitive guarantee.
5. No buyer contact, bid, payment or false identity; revisit whether to pursue
   once the above facts exist.

 (defn bt-arg [action arg]
  (write ".bt-arg.tmp" arg)
  (sh (str "node browser-tool.mjs " action " --arg-file .bt-arg.tmp")))
(defn bt-noarg [action] (sh (str "node browser-tool.mjs " action)))
(defn bt-eval [js] (bt-arg "eval" js))
(defn bt-links [] (bt-noarg "links"))
(defn bt-open [url] (bt-arg "open" url))
(defn page-text [] (bt-eval "document.body.innerText"))
(defn page-url [] (bt-eval "location.href"))
(defn capture-evidence [label url text] (write (str "evidence-" label ".txt") (str "URL: " url "\n\n" text "\n")))
(defn ma-keyword [kw]
  (bt-open "https://www.marchespublics.gov.ma/index.php?page=entreprise.EntrepriseAdvancedSearch&searchAnnCons")
  (bt-eval (str "var el=document.querySelector('#ctl0_CONTENU_PAGE_AdvancedSearch_keywordSearch'); el.value=" (pr-str kw) "; document.querySelector('#ctl0_CONTENU_PAGE_AdvancedSearch_lancerRecherche').click(); 'submitted'"))
  (page-text))
(defn ma-rows []
  (bt-eval "JSON.stringify([...document.querySelectorAll('tr')].map(r=>({text:(r.innerText||'').replace(/\\s+/g,' ').trim().slice(0,700),hrefs:[...r.querySelectorAll('a')].map(a=>a.href).filter(h=>h.includes('EntrepriseDetailsConsultation')||h.includes('EntrepriseDetailConsultation'))})).filter(r=>r.text.length>10))"))
(defn fr-place-open [] (bt-open "https://www.marches-publics.gouv.fr/"))
(defn fr-place-text [] (page-text))
(defn fr-place-search [kw]
  (bt-open "https://www.marches-publics.gouv.fr/")
  (bt-eval (str "var inputs=[...document.querySelectorAll('input[type=text],input:not([type]),textarea')]; var el=inputs.find(e=>e.placeholder&&/mot|recherche|keyword|objet/i.test(e.placeholder+e.name+e.id)); if(!el) el=inputs[0]; el.value=" (pr-str kw) "; if(el.form){el.form.requestSubmit?el.form.requestSubmit():el.form.submit()} else {el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));} 'sent'"))
  (page-text))
(defn fr-place-links [] (bt-links))
(defn ted-open [path] (bt-open (str "https://ted.europa.eu" path)))
(defn ted-search [q]
  (let [query (str/replace q " " "%20")]
    (ted-open (str "/en/search/result?query=" query))
    (page-text)))
(defn ted-text [] (page-text))
(defn ted-links [] (bt-links))

(defn ie-etenders-open [path] (bt-open (str "https://www.etenders.gov.ie" path)))
(defn ie-etenders-text [] (page-text))
(defn ie-etenders-links [] (bt-links))
(defn ie-etenders-url [] (page-url))

  (bt-open "https://www.etenders.gov.ie/epps/prepareAdvancedSearch.do?type=cftFTS")
  (bt-eval (str "var el=document.querySelector('#Title'); el.value=" (pr-str kw) "; var f=el.form; f.requestSubmit?f.requestSubmit():f.submit(); 'submitted'"))
  (bt-links))
(defn ie-etenders-set-search [title status]
  (bt-eval (str "var t=document.querySelector('#Title'); var s=document.querySelector('#Status'); if(t)t.value=" (pr-str title) "; if(s){s.value=" (pr-str status) "; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));} var f=document.querySelector('form'); f.requestSubmit?f.requestSubmit():f.submit(); 'submitted'")))

(defn bt-download [target dest] (sh (str "node browser-tool.mjs download " target " " dest)))

(defn probe-download-links []
  (bt-eval "JSON.stringify([...document.querySelectorAll('[id*=ownload],[id*=Dce],[id*=DCE]')].map(e=>({tag:e.tagName,id:e.id,txt:(e.innerText||'').trim().slice(0,60),href:e.getAttribute('href')})))"))
(defn bt-download-q [target dest]
  (sh (str "node browser-tool.mjs download '" target "' " dest)))


;; v8 ONMT qualification: local DCE page extraction + evidence saving
(defn dce-page [file & nums]
  (sh (str "node pages.mjs " file " " (str/join " " (map str nums)))))

* Search strategy
- Match Ora's demonstrated services to notices about AI, CRM/ERP, process automation, digital transformation, market strategy/communications.
- Morocco: official Portail Marocain des Marchés Publics (PMMP) advanced search, current consultations only, French keywords.
- France: PLACE (marches-publics.gouv.fr) is the state procurement platform; BOAMP content redirects to PLACE. Use official site, not aggregators.
- EU-wide: TED (ted.europa.eu) is the authoritative EU supplement; use buyer/official notice URL as the final evidence.
- Every final recommendation must have original buyer/portal evidence URL. Search-engine results are leads only.

* Source limitations
- PMMP is ASP.NET/Prado; refs and hidden form state change, so functions target stable element ids where possible.
- PLACE and TED may be client-heavy or block automation; report any block and try an alternate official source.
- Keyword search can miss notices that use equivalent terms (e.g. système d'information, transformation digitale, plateforme, automatisation).
